gloss: before the Buddha; Buddhist altar offering; condolence gift inscription (from the 49th day)

definitions.gloss: before the Buddha; offering placed before a Buddhist altar; condolence gift so inscribed
definitions.explanation: Literally "before the honored Buddha." Refers to the space before a Buddhist altar and to offerings placed there, and is the standard inscription written on the envelope of a condolence money gift ({香典|こうでん}) given at Buddhist memorial services from the 49th-day rite ({四十九日|しじゅうくにち}) onward, once the deceased is regarded as having become a Buddha.

examples.japanese: {御仏前|ごぶつぜん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧お⟦{花|はな}→花：00523_hana⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{供|そな}える→供える：11562_sonaeru⟧。
⟦{法要|ほうよう}→法要：05924_houyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧「{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}」⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{書|か}いた→書く：00477_kaku⟧⟦{香典|こうでん}→香典：06127_kouden⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}って→持つ：00478_motsu⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I brought condolence money marked "gobutsuzen" to the memorial service.

examples.japanese: ⟦{四十九日|しじゅうくにち}→四十九日：06017_shijuukunichi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{過|す}ぎたら→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧、{表書|おもてが}き⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧「⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧」⟦では→では：02945_deha⟧⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧「{御仏前|ごぶつぜん}」⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: After the 49th day has passed, use "gobutsuzen" rather than "goreizen" on the envelope.

notes:
Formed from the honorific prefix {御|ご} + ⟦{仏前|ぶつぜん}→仏前：29524_butsuzen⟧ (before the Buddha). Written on the outside of condolence envelopes.

USAGE:
The choice of inscription depends on timing. Before the 49th-day rite the soul is not yet a Buddha, so ⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧ (before the spirit) is used; from the 49th day onward {御仏前|ごぶつぜん} is correct. Sect differences exist, so when unsure ⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧ is the safer default at a wake or funeral.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{御霊前|ごれいぜん}→御霊前：24486_goreizen⟧: before the spirit — used up to and including the funeral and wake, before the 49th day.
- {御香典|おこうでん}: condolence money — the general term for the gift itself, regardless of inscription.
